question: In an electric motor, the direction of currents flowing through the arms of the coil will be ___________ to each other due to Fleming's left hand rule.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Opposite**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Fleming's Left-hand rule __states that if we arrange our thumb, forefinger, and middle finger of the left - hand perpendicular (900) to each other, then the thumb points towards the direction of the force experienced by the conductor, the forefinger points towards the direction of magnetic field and the middle finger points towards the direction of electric current.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• When a current-carrying conductor is placed in an external magnetic field, the conductor experiences a force perpendicular to both the field and the current flow's direction.
 
• Application of Fleming's left-hand rule-
 
• Fleming's left-hand rule is used to find the direction of the force acting on the current-carrying conductor placed in a magnetic field.
 
• This rule is used for Electric motors.

 
• Fleming's right-hand rule __states that if we arrange our thumb, forefinger, and middle finger of the right-hand perpendicular to each other, then the thumb points towards the direction of motion of the conductor relative to the magnetic field, the forefinger points towards the direction of magnetic field and the middle finger points towards the direction of the induced current.
 
• This rule is used for Electric Generators.
